en.bdb: Famous tale of Ram and Ravan

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋਇਨ ਲੰਕਾ ਵਡਾ ਗੜੁ ਖਾਰ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਜਿਵੇਹੀ ਖਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: soin la(n)kaa vaddaa gaR khaar samu(n)dh jivehee khaiee|

en.bdb: Golden Lanka was a grand fort and the ocean around it was like a vast moat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਪੁਤੁ ਪੋਤੇ ਸਵਾ ਲਖੁ ਕੁੰਭਕਰਣੁ ਮਹਿਰਾਵਣੁ ਭਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh put pote savaa lakh ku(n)bhakaran mahiraavan bhaiee|

en.bdb: Ravan had one lac sons, one and a quarter lac grand sons and brothers like Kumbhkaran and Mahiravari.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਵਣੁ ਬੁਹਾਰੀ ਦੇਇ ਨਿਤਿ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਭਰੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਰੑਹਿਆਈ।
verses.translit_en: pavan buhaaree dhei nit i(n)dhr bharai paanee var(h)hiaaiee|

en.bdb: Air would broom his palaces whereas Indr through rains carried water for him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੈਸੰਤੁਰ ਰਾਸੋਈਆ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਚੰਦੁ ਚਰਾਗ ਦੀਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: baisa(n)tur raasoieeaa sooraj cha(n)dh charaag dheepaiee|

en.bdb: Fire was his cook and the sun and the moon his lamp burners.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਖੂਹਣਿ ਚਤੁਰੰਗ ਦਲ ਦੇਸ ਨ ਵੇਸ ਨ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: bahu khoohan chatura(n)g dhal dhes na ves na keemat paiee|

en.bdb: His huge army of horses, elephants, chariots and infantry comprising many khuhants (akeauhauts, one aksauhani is known as a mixed force of 21870 elephants, 21870 chariots, 65610 horse and 109350 foot soldiers) was such whose power and grandeur cannot be e

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਦੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਰਹਦੇ ਸਰਣਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: mahaadhev dhee sev kar dhev dhaanav rahadhe saranaiee|

en.bdb: He (Ravan) had served Mahadev (Siva) and due to this all the gods and demons were under his shelter.
But evil intellect and actions earned him infamy.
